text: Unibet is a brand of Kindred, one of Europe's leading online betting and gaming companies; FDJ (today FDJ UNITED) launched a recommended all-cash tender offer for Kindred in January 2024 to create a European gaming champion.
short: Unibet is a Kindred brand; FDJ made a tender offer for Kindred in 2024

source.name: FDJ — FDJ launches a recommended all-cash tender offer for Kindred to create a European Gaming Champion (press release)
source.quote: Kindred is one of Europe's leading online betting and gaming companies, operating the Unibet brand
